stem.text: A sprinter takes a time of $11.0\,\text{s}$ to run a $100\,\text{m}$ race. She first accelerates uniformly from rest, reaching a speed of $10\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. She then runs at a constant speed of $10\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ until the finish line.
What is the uniform acceleration of the sprinter for the first part of the race?
